column18: Claims superior energy efficiency of Spiking-UNet for SAR change detection; no ANN comparator or figures stated.
EESE encoding: 26% energy savings, 0.101 W total power on FPGA, 97% accuracy; pruning one of several techniques.
Energy about half of most current methods; accuracy 99.85% at 15 Msps, 1.61% above best existing method.
Spiking graph transformer claims low computational cost; no ANN efficiency comparison or figures given.
Spiking transformer claims energy efficiency and speed with no comparator or figures; adversarial accuracy gains 3.60-4.01%.
Competitive accuracy with significantly lower computational overhead than conventional deep learning; no figures given.
SNN learning processor, 5.3 pJ/SOP, 99.2% MNIST accuracy; compared only with its own baseline architecture, no ANN comparison.
SNN with event camera uses 11.7% of the energy of an ANN-based model (88.3% reduction) on quadruped parkour.
SNN and ESN give significant energy savings versus CNN and MLP with comparable accuracy; no figures in abstract.
Overview of event-based imaging with neuromorphic hardware plus trials; asserts latency and efficiency gains, no figures.
Event-based GRU with graded spikes compared with classical SNNs on task performance; no efficiency comparison or figures.

IWT winning-ticket search for NVR; +1.81, +4.19, +3.5 dB over original pruning at 90% sparsity (NeRV, E-NeRV, HNeRV).
